basic_info.description: Tremendous investment opportunity! All units are very spacious and located between Inner & Central Sunset rental location. Top floor (1247) has 3 bedrooms, and middle floor (1249) has 3 bedrooms each. 1 block to Golden Gate Park, Irving Street restaurants & shops. Conveniently close to UC Medical Campus, Stonestown Shopping Mall, SF State University. Easy access to transportation, MUNI Bus Lines and freeways. Garage can park 2 small cars tandem.
